name: rainbolt.ai
tagline: Upload a photo of a place and get its likely location with street views, map link and cultural facts.

awards: Best UI Hack Sponsored By Conrad Mo

problem: Finding where a photo was taken is hard.
solution: Image embeddings matched against a vector index plus an LLM identify the location with confidence, show nearby street-view images, link coordinates and explain the reasoning.
demo_moment: Team-described: drop in a holiday photo and see where it was taken.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best UI Hack Sponsored By Conrad Mo” among 124 submissions.
Named after a well-known geography-guessing player.
Shows its reasoning, not just an answer.

lessons: A polished interface with visible reasoning wins UI prizes.
